dialogues.en: "Yaaawn..."
dialogues.text: "Yaaawn..."

dialogues.jp: 時計を見る。針は、１１時を指していた。
dialogues.en: I glanced at the clock. The hour hand just hit 11.
dialogues.text: I glanced at the clock. The hour hand just hit 11.

dialogues.jp:
「……ま、１時間もあれば、身だしなみは充分
　整えられるよな……」
dialogues.en: "...One hour should be enough to get ready..."
dialogues.text: "...One hour should be enough to get ready..."

dialogues.jp:
休みに入ってからというもの、禿げオヤジの額
のように起きる時間が後退していた。
dialogues.en: Any more rest would be for old balding men.
dialogues.text: Any more rest would be for old balding men.

dialogues.jp:
ことりは今日、委員会としての仕事で学園に用
があるらしく、それで、校門での待ち合わせに
した。
dialogues.en:
Kotori has a committee meeting today at school, so we're
meeting at the school gates.
dialogues.text:
Kotori has a committee meeting today at school, so we're
meeting at the school gates.

dialogues.jp: 「おはよ〜……って、誰も居ない」
dialogues.en: "Good morning~..., eh, no one's here?"
dialogues.text: "Good morning~..., eh, no one's here?"

dialogues.jp: テーブルの上に、メモ書きが残されていた。
dialogues.en: I picked up the note on the table.
dialogues.text: I picked up the note on the table.

dialogues.jp:
「兄さんへ。出かけてきます。食器棚に菓子パ
　ンが入ってますからどうぞ……か」
dialogues.en:
"Brother, I've went out. There's some sweet buns in the
cupboard."
dialogues.text:
"Brother, I've went out. There's some sweet buns in the
cupboard."

dialogues.jp:
お湯を沸かし、コーヒーを淹れ、菓子パンをま
ぐまぐやる。
dialogues.en:
I boiled some water, prepared the coffee, and munched on
some sweet buns.
dialogues.text:
I boiled some water, prepared the coffee, and munched on
some sweet buns.

dialogues.jp: 「一昨日から、音夢と全然喋ってねえな……」
dialogues.en: "Yesterday, Nemu didn't talk to me at all..."
dialogues.text: "Yesterday, Nemu didn't talk to me at all..."

dialogues.jp:
ことりと俺がああいう風になった事は、音夢も
知ったらしく、そのせいなのか、俺に対して変
によそよそしくなってしまった。
dialogues.en:
She had heard about what Kotori and I had done during the
Miss Kazami Academy Contest, so I was in for the cold
shoulder.
dialogues.text:
She had heard about what Kotori and I had done during the
Miss Kazami Academy Contest, so I was in for the cold
shoulder.

dialogues.jp:
まともに俺の顔を見ようとしないし、会話もま
るきり続かないのだ。
dialogues.en:
She wouldn't look me in the face, or answer any questions
beyond a single-syllable response.
dialogues.text:
She wouldn't look me in the face, or answer any questions
beyond a single-syllable response.

dialogues.jp: 「ま、時が経てば、また元に戻るよな」
dialogues.en: "...Well, it'd get better with time."
dialogues.text: "...Well, it'd get better with time."

dialogues.jp:
コーヒーをぐっと飲み込み、そう自分に言い聞
かせた。
dialogues.en: I drank my coffee and started talking to myself.
dialogues.text: I drank my coffee and started talking to myself.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「あ、時間ぴったりだね。こんちわー」
dialogues.en: "Ah, right on time! Good afternoon~"
dialogues.text: "Ah, right on time! Good afternoon~"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「こんちはっす。待った？」
dialogues.en: "Afternoon. Did I make you wait?"
dialogues.text: "Afternoon. Did I make you wait?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ううん。だって、時間ぴったりだもん」
dialogues.en: "Nope! Like I said, right on time."
dialogues.text: "Nope! Like I said, right on time."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ま、そうだけどさ」
dialogues.en: "Well, I guess so."
dialogues.text: "Well, I guess so."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ん？　どうしたの？　顔がにやけてるよ」
dialogues.en: "Hm? Is something wrong? You look disappointed."
dialogues.text: "Hm? Is something wrong? You look disappointed."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「あ〜、いや……何て言うか、“待った？”な
　んてやりとり、本当にやるもんだなあと思っ
　てさ」
dialogues.en:
"Well, no... how do you say it... I just didn't think I'd be
saying things like "Did I make you wait?"."
dialogues.text:
"Well, no... how do you say it... I just didn't think I'd be
saying things like "Did I make you wait?"."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「まるで、ドラマみたい？」
dialogues.en: "Like a drama serial?"
dialogues.text: "Like a drama serial?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ま、男優が俺ってのが、心許ないけどな」
dialogues.en: "I hardly think you can call me any good like that..."
dialogues.text: "I hardly think you can call me any good like that..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「そんな事ないよぅ」
dialogues.en: "That's not true."
dialogues.text: "That's not true."

dialogues.jp: ことりは、俺の胸にそっと手の平を置いた。
dialogues.en: Kotori gently placed her hand on my chest.
dialogues.text: Kotori gently placed her hand on my chest.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「なんてったって、私の彼氏さんなんだから」
dialogues.en: "You're my boyfriend, after all."
dialogues.text: "You're my boyfriend, after all."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「……恥ずかしくないか？」
dialogues.en: "...Embarassed?"
dialogues.text: "...Embarassed?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「素で返さないでよ〜」
dialogues.en: "I can't change my face so easily~"
dialogues.text: "I can't change my face so easily~"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ごほん……それじゃ、行きましょうか」
dialogues.en: "Ehem... anyway, let's go."
dialogues.text: "Ehem... anyway, let's go."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ああ。けど、どこに？」
dialogues.en: "Okay. Where to?"
dialogues.text: "Okay. Where to?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「散歩と買い物。いい天気になって良かったよ
　ね」
dialogues.en: "Just walking and shopping. It'd be great in this weather."
dialogues.text: "Just walking and shopping. It'd be great in this weather."

dialogues.jp:
そう言ってことりは、真っ青に晴れた空を｛まぶ／眩｝し
げに見上げる。
dialogues.en: Kotori looked up at the dazzling blue sky as she talked.
dialogues.text: Kotori looked up at the dazzling blue sky as she talked.

dialogues.jp:
そして俺は、そんなことりの笑顔を、眩しげに
見つめている……。
dialogues.en: And I stared at her dazzling smile instead...
dialogues.text: And I stared at her dazzling smile instead...

dialogues.jp:
「なんかさ……さっきから、通り過ぎる学生が、
　俺らの事ちらちら見てない？」
dialogues.en: "Huh... were those students glancing at me just now?"
dialogues.text: "Huh... were those students glancing at me just now?"

dialogues.jp:
大方、補習でもあるんだろう。今も、こちらを
窺っていた男子学生が、背中側へと回ったばか
りだ。くるっと振り返る。
dialogues.en:
I suppose they're going for extra lessons. I quickly turned
my head back, and caught one of them. He quickly turned his
back.
dialogues.text:
I suppose they're going for extra lessons. I quickly turned
my head back, and caught one of them. He quickly turned his
back.

dialogues.jp:
案の定というか、こっちを見ていやがった。横っ
面を張られたように、その顔があちらへと向い
た。
dialogues.en:
Sure enough, I'm getting curious looks. I could see it on
people's faces as I passed by them.
dialogues.text:
Sure enough, I'm getting curious looks. I could see it on
people's faces as I passed by them.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「それは仕方ないよ。だって私達、ちょっとし
　た有名人になっちゃったんだから」
dialogues.en:
"It can't be helped. We're essentially school celebrities
now..."
dialogues.text:
"It can't be helped. We're essentially school celebrities
now..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「まあ、なあ……」
dialogues.en: "I suppose..."
dialogues.text: "I suppose..."

dialogues.jp:
衆人環視の中、壇上でキスなんてやらかせば、
そりゃ有名になるに決まってる。
dialogues.en:
Kissing on stage with an entire audience looking, it'd be
hard NOT to become famous from that.
dialogues.text:
Kissing on stage with an entire audience looking, it'd be
hard NOT to become famous from that.

dialogues.jp:
「でも、ま、春休みを挟んでるしな。新しい学
　年が始まる頃には、ほとぼりも冷めてるだろ」
dialogues.en:
"At least it was right before springtime. Now all the new
students will come in, and that situation will slowly die
down."
dialogues.text:
"At least it was right before springtime. Now all the new
students will come in, and that situation will slowly die
down."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「ほとぼりって言っても、悪いことじゃないよ
　ね」
dialogues.en: "Dying down... that wouldn't be bad at all."
dialogues.text: "Dying down... that wouldn't be bad at all."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「そりゃ決まってる」
dialogues.en: "Of course."
dialogues.text: "Of course."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「うん」
dialogues.en: "Yeah."
dialogues.text: "Yeah."

dialogues.jp:
風が気持ちいい。天気もいいし、実際、散歩に
は持ってこいの日だった。
dialogues.en:
The wind was perfect, the weather was good. It was a perfect
day for just walking around and enjoying nature.
dialogues.text:
The wind was perfect, the weather was good. It was a perfect
day for just walking around and enjoying nature.

dialogues.jp:
緩やかな風に乗って、桜の花びらがひらひらと
飛んでいた。
dialogues.en: The gentle wind scattered the sakura petals all around us.
dialogues.text: The gentle wind scattered the sakura petals all around us.

dialogues.jp:
両手を空に向け、花びらを受け止めるような仕
草をしながら、ことりが言った。
dialogues.en:
Kotori spread her arms out, as if trying to stop the sakura
petals around her, and begin speaking.
dialogues.text:
Kotori spread her arms out, as if trying to stop the sakura
petals around her, and begin speaking.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「一年中桜が咲いているのもつまらないな……」
dialogues.en:
"It's a little boring to have sakura that blooms all year
around..."
dialogues.text:
"It's a little boring to have sakura that blooms all year
around..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ん？　何で？」
dialogues.en: "Hm? What do you mean?"
dialogues.text: "Hm? What do you mean?"

dialogues.jp: 目を細めてその光景を眺めていた俺が尋ねる。
dialogues.en:
I narrowed my eyes and looked at the scenery around me as I
queried her.
dialogues.text:
I narrowed my eyes and looked at the scenery around me as I
queried her.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「だって、改めてお花見しようとか、そういう
　気持ちになれなくない？」
dialogues.en:
"I mean, it's like there's no real special occasion to going
flower-viewing now."
dialogues.text:
"I mean, it's like there's no real special occasion to going
flower-viewing now."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「まあ、そうかもな。見慣れているというか、
　見飽きてるし」
dialogues.en:
"Yeah, I guess. If you see something too much, you get sick
of seeing it."
dialogues.text:
"Yeah, I guess. If you see something too much, you get sick
of seeing it."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「でも、さ」
dialogues.en: "But, you know..."
dialogues.text: "But, you know..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.en: "Mm?"
dialogues.text: "Mm?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「今度、お花見しよう？　ふたりっきりで」
dialogues.en:
"Next time, do you want to go flower-viewing? Just the two
of us."
dialogues.text:
"Next time, do you want to go flower-viewing? Just the two
of us."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「そうだな」
dialogues.en: "Sounds good."
dialogues.text: "Sounds good."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「私、とびっきりのお弁当を作ってくる」
dialogues.en: "I'd make a good lunch for us as well."
dialogues.text: "I'd make a good lunch for us as well."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「いいな。せっかくの春休みだもんな」
dialogues.en: "That'd be great. A perfect start to spring break."
dialogues.text: "That'd be great. A perfect start to spring break."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「うん」
dialogues.en: "Okay!"
dialogues.text: "Okay!"

dialogues.jp: 一緒にいる。
dialogues.en: The two of us, together.
dialogues.text: The two of us, together.

dialogues.jp:
ただそれだけなのに、どうしてこんなにも心が
弾むんだろう？
dialogues.en:
It should be a normal occurence, yet why does it make my
heart flutter so?
dialogues.text:
It should be a normal occurence, yet why does it make my
heart flutter so?

dialogues.jp:
今までだって、ことりとふたりきりで会ったこ
とはあったのに、こんな気持ちにはなれなかっ
た。
dialogues.en:
Now, I can't imagine not having met her, not having felt
this way...
dialogues.text:
Now, I can't imagine not having met her, not having felt
this way...

dialogues.jp: 「不思議だな……ん？」
dialogues.en: "It's so strange... huh?"
dialogues.text: "It's so strange... huh?"

dialogues.jp:
俺がことりを見ると、ことりが頬を赤く染めて、
こちらを見ていた。
dialogues.en:
I glanced at Kotori, and noticed her cheeks were fushed with
red.
dialogues.text:
I glanced at Kotori, and noticed her cheeks were fushed with
red.

dialogues.jp: 「どうした？　ことり」
dialogues.en: "What's wrong, Kotori?"
dialogues.text: "What's wrong, Kotori?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「えっと……」

視線を落とし、もじもじと人差し指同士を突っ
つき合わせた。
dialogues.en:
She started looking at the ground, her index fingers playing
with each other.
dialogues.text:
She started looking at the ground, her index fingers playing
with each other.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「いつになったら手を繋いでくれるのかな……
　なんて」
dialogues.en: "Are we...going to hold hands?"
dialogues.text: "Are we...going to hold hands?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ずっと、待ってるんだけどな……」
dialogues.en: "I've been waiting a long time for that..."
dialogues.text: "I've been waiting a long time for that..."

dialogues.jp:
さっきよりももっと赤い頬で、ちらりとこちら
を窺ってくる。
dialogues.en:
Her cheeks were still redder than tomatoes, but I caught her
sneaking a nervous glance at me.
dialogues.text:
Her cheeks were still redder than tomatoes, but I caught her
sneaking a nervous glance at me.

dialogues.jp: 「……お待たせ」
dialogues.en: "...Sorry for making you wait."
dialogues.text: "...Sorry for making you wait."

dialogues.jp:
そう言って手を差し伸べるのに、かなり勇気が
必要だったが。
dialogues.en:
Saying something like that and extending my arm took more
courage than I thought it would.
dialogues.text:
Saying something like that and extending my arm took more
courage than I thought it would.

dialogues.jp:
ことりが嬉しそうな笑みを浮かべて、きゅっと
握り返してきてくれると、それだけでもう満た
された。
dialogues.en:
Kotori smiled joyfully, and tightly held my hand. She seemed
so satisfied just from that...
dialogues.text:
Kotori smiled joyfully, and tightly held my hand. She seemed
so satisfied just from that...

dialogues.jp:
「買い物って……何か買うの？　それとも、ウ
　インドウショッピングって奴？」
dialogues.en:
"Shopping, though... what do you want to buy? Or are you
just window shopping?"
dialogues.text:
"Shopping, though... what do you want to buy? Or are you
just window shopping?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「ウインドウショッピングもいいけど、買う物
　はちゃんとあるよ」
dialogues.en:
"Window shopping is good, but I do have something in mind
today."
dialogues.text:
"Window shopping is good, but I do have something in mind
today."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「お姉ちゃんの、結婚祝いの品を買おうと思う
　の」
dialogues.en:
"I was thinking of looking for a wedding present for my
sister."
dialogues.text:
"I was thinking of looking for a wedding present for my
sister."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「……ああ、暦先生の」
dialogues.en: "...Ahh, for Koyomi-sensei."
dialogues.text: "...Ahh, for Koyomi-sensei."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「そろそろ挙式が近づいてきたから。５月の６
　日。大安じゃないって、嫌そうにしてたよ」
dialogues.en:
"It's getting closer and closer, the 6th of May to be exact.
It's not really an auspicious day, though..."
dialogues.text:
"It's getting closer and closer, the 6th of May to be exact.
It's not really an auspicious day, though..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「お姉ちゃん、普段はあんな風なのに、縁起を
　担ぐなんておかしいよね」
dialogues.en:
"She doesn't really care about things like that, I hope she
doesn't have to carry the burden of it after..."
dialogues.text:
"She doesn't really care about things like that, I hope she
doesn't have to carry the burden of it after..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「……どうかした？　何か、変な顔してるよ」
dialogues.en: "...What are you thinking? Your face looks weird."
dialogues.text: "...What are you thinking? Your face looks weird."

dialogues.jp: 人差し指で、頬をつんつんしてくる。
dialogues.en: She pointed at my cheeks.
dialogues.text: She pointed at my cheeks.

dialogues.en: "Ah, nothing..."
dialogues.text: "Ah, nothing..."

dialogues.jp: 強いて笑みを浮かべる。
dialogues.en: I smiled as wide as I could.
dialogues.text: I smiled as wide as I could.

dialogues.jp: 「何でもない」
dialogues.en: "Nothing's wrong."
dialogues.text: "Nothing's wrong."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「……ならいいんだけど」
dialogues.en: "...If you say so..."
dialogues.text: "...If you say so..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「あ、ほら、あれなんかどうかな？」
dialogues.en: "Ah, hey, what's that?"
dialogues.text: "Ah, hey, what's that?"

dialogues.jp: 手を引き、とあるウインドウへと連れていく。
dialogues.en: She led me by the arm to a nearby window.
dialogues.text: She led me by the arm to a nearby window.

dialogues.jp: 前に見た、夢の事を考えていたのだ。
dialogues.en: I was thinking about the dream I saw a few days ago.
dialogues.text: I was thinking about the dream I saw a few days ago.

dialogues.jp:
あの夢の登場人物が、本当に、目の前に居るこ
とりだったとするならば……。
dialogues.en: That dream, was the person dreaming it really Kotori?
dialogues.text: That dream, was the person dreaming it really Kotori?

dialogues.jp:
暦先生も含めて、ことりの家族は、みんな血が
繋がっていない事になる。
dialogues.en:
If it's true, then Kotori has no blood-ties to the rest of
her family, and Koyomi-sensei...
dialogues.text:
If it's true, then Kotori has no blood-ties to the rest of
her family, and Koyomi-sensei...

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「ああ……ちょっと高いか。私のお小遣いじゃ
　買えないなあ……」
dialogues.en:
"Ahh... it's too expensive. My allowance isn't enough for
that..."
dialogues.text:
"Ahh... it's too expensive. My allowance isn't enough for
that..."

dialogues.jp:
ウインドウに映ることりの顔は、何の憂いも帯
びていない。純粋に、姉の慶事を喜んでいるみ
たいだった。
dialogues.en:
Kotori, her face almost right up against the window, had an
unhappy expression. She truely wanted to do as much as she
could...
dialogues.text:
Kotori, her face almost right up against the window, had an
unhappy expression. She truely wanted to do as much as she
could...

dialogues.jp: 「……なあ、ことり」
dialogues.en: "...Hey, Kotori."
dialogues.text: "...Hey, Kotori."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.en: "Hm?"
dialogues.text: "Hm?"

dialogues.jp:
窓の中のことりが顔を上げた。お互いに、窓ガ
ラスで見つめ合う。
dialogues.en:
Kotori looked up, still facing the glass. We stared at each
other's reflections.
dialogues.text:
Kotori looked up, still facing the glass. We stared at each
other's reflections.

dialogues.jp: 「その……暦先生ってさ」
dialogues.en: "You know... about Koyomi-sensei..."
dialogues.text: "You know... about Koyomi-sensei..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「うん」
dialogues.en: "Yeah?"
dialogues.text: "Yeah?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「……いや、やっぱ何でもない」
dialogues.en: "...No, never mind."
dialogues.text: "...No, never mind."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「ん〜？　言いかけて止めちゃうのって、何だ
　か気持ち悪いよぉ〜」
dialogues.en: "Whaat~? It's bad when you leave people hanging like that~"
dialogues.text: "Whaat~? It's bad when you leave people hanging like that~"

dialogues.jp: 笑いを含んだ視線で、窓の中から｛にら／睨｝んでくる。
dialogues.en: Kotori admonished me with a smile, still through the glass.
dialogues.text: Kotori admonished me with a smile, still through the glass.

dialogues.jp:
「ああ、別に大したことじゃない。ただ、見合
　いで結婚したのかな？　って気になっただけ
　で」
dialogues.en:
"Ahh, don't worry, it's nothing big. By the way, it wasn't
an arranged marriage or anything like that, right?"
dialogues.text:
"Ahh, don't worry, it's nothing big. By the way, it wasn't
an arranged marriage or anything like that, right?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「えっと、お見合いはした事なかったと思うよ」
dialogues.en: "Ehm, not as far as I know."
dialogues.text: "Ehm, not as far as I know."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「じゃ、やっぱ恋愛結婚か。うん、そっちのほ
　うが暦先生らしいよな」
dialogues.en:
"Then it's a marriage out of love. That's a lot more like
Koyomi-sensei."
dialogues.text:
"Then it's a marriage out of love. That's a lot more like
Koyomi-sensei."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「うん？　らしい……のかな？」
dialogues.en: "Huh? That's... like her?"
dialogues.text: "Huh? That's... like her?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「ま、ま。だから大したことじゃないって言っ
　たじゃん。気にしない気にしない。それより、
　あれなんかどうだ？」
dialogues.en:
"Yep, yep! That's why I said it was nothing. Don't worry
about it. Anyway, what's that?"
dialogues.text:
"Yep, yep! That's why I said it was nothing. Don't worry
about it. Anyway, what's that?"

dialogues.jp:
窓の中を適当に指差す。目を向けたことりは、
あれも値段がなあ、などと呟いた。
dialogues.en:
I pointed at something being shown in the window. Kotori
shifted her gaze to that, and started murmuring the price to
herself.
dialogues.text:
I pointed at something being shown in the window. Kotori
shifted her gaze to that, and started murmuring the price to
herself.

dialogues.jp:
やっぱり、夢見る能力については、軽々しく口
には出来なかった。それは言ってみれば、プラ
イバシーの侵害なのだ。
dialogues.en:
I really shouldn't say anything about the dream I saw.
Somehow, I feel like that's an invasion of privacy.
dialogues.text:
I really shouldn't say anything about the dream I saw.
Somehow, I feel like that's an invasion of privacy.

dialogues.jp:
ことりの家族の問題にしたって、彼女自身の口
から語られるのを待つべきだろう。
dialogues.en:
I'd just wait for the time where Kotori decides to tell me
about her family problems herself.
dialogues.text:
I'd just wait for the time where Kotori decides to tell me
about her family problems herself.

dialogues.jp:
そもそも、問題ですらないかもしれない。とい
うか、そっちの可能性の方が強い。
dialogues.en:
Unless she does that, It shouldn't be that big of a problem.
The possibility of that is strong, methinks.
dialogues.text:
Unless she does that, It shouldn't be that big of a problem.
The possibility of that is strong, methinks.

dialogues.jp:
こんな風に、楽しげにプレゼント選びに興じて
いるのならば──。
dialogues.en:
After all, look at the way she's so happily choosing a
present for her older sist--
dialogues.text:
After all, look at the way she's so happily choosing a
present for her older sist--

dialogues.jp:
冷ややかな視線を感じてその視線の持ち主を捜
せば、ガラスに映ったことりの目だった。
dialogues.en:
I suddenly felt conscious about myself, and I returned to
the real world to see Kotori back to staring at me through
the glass.
dialogues.text:
I suddenly felt conscious about myself, and I returned to
the real world to see Kotori back to staring at me through
the glass.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉君ってさ……」
dialogues.en: "Asakura-kun, you're..."
dialogues.text: "Asakura-kun, you're..."

dialogues.jp: しばしの間。と、くるりと振り返った。
dialogues.en:
I quickly turned to face her real self rather than her
reflection.
dialogues.text:
I quickly turned to face her real self rather than her
reflection.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「うふふ、やっぱり、何でもない♪」
dialogues.en: "Ehehe, on second thought, never mind♪"
dialogues.text: "Ehehe, on second thought, never mind♪"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「……な、何だよ。さっきの仕返しか？」
dialogues.en: "...W, what is that? Payback?"
dialogues.text: "...W, what is that? Payback?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「さぁて、どうでしょうかね？」
dialogues.en: "Hm, I don't know. Maybe?"
dialogues.text: "Hm, I don't know. Maybe?"

dialogues.jp: くすくすと笑う。楽しげに……。
dialogues.en: She was giggling. She seems so happy...
dialogues.text: She was giggling. She seems so happy...

dialogues.jp: そこに居るのは、いつものことりだった。
dialogues.en: What I'm seeing now, the ever-cheerful Kotori.
dialogues.text: What I'm seeing now, the ever-cheerful Kotori.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「う〜……どうもこの店は高いよね。他のとこ
　行こ」
dialogues.en:
"Uu~... these items are too rich for my blood. Let's go
somewhere else!"
dialogues.text:
"Uu~... these items are too rich for my blood. Let's go
somewhere else!"

dialogues.jp:
手を引き、てくてくと歩いていく。その繋がり
は本物だ。けど……。
dialogues.en:
She took my hand again, and started walking. This link
between us was real. But...
dialogues.text:
She took my hand again, and started walking. This link
between us was real. But...

dialogues.jp: 俺は何だか、妙な気持ちを抱いてしまっていた。
dialogues.en: I still carried uneasy feelings with me.
dialogues.text: I still carried uneasy feelings with me.

dialogues.jp: 隠し事をしているのは、俺ばかりじゃない？
dialogues.en:
I don't think I'm the only one with many secrets to hide,
here.
dialogues.text:
I don't think I'm the only one with many secrets to hide,
here.

dialogues.jp:
俺達は、お互いに、相手に見せられない何かを
抱えているのだろうか？
dialogues.en:
We're on the same level there, so why can't we admit it to
each other...?
dialogues.text:
We're on the same level there, so why can't we admit it to
each other...?

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉君」
dialogues.en: "Asakura-kun."
dialogues.text: "Asakura-kun."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.en: "Hm?"
dialogues.text: "Hm?"

dialogues.jp:
それはまるで、お互いが、お互いの虚像を見つ
めているかのようで……。
dialogues.en: So is what we're having now, really what we should be doing?
dialogues.text: So is what we're having now, really what we should be doing?

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「……好きだよ。本当に、朝倉君のことが好き」
dialogues.en: "...I love you. I really love you, Asakura-kun."
dialogues.text: "...I love you. I really love you, Asakura-kun."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「……ああ。俺も。俺も、ほんとにことりが好
　きだ」
dialogues.en: "...Ahh. I do too. I love you, Kotori."
dialogues.text: "...Ahh. I do too. I love you, Kotori."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「うん」
この気持ちだけは本当だった。
dialogues.en: At the very least, I know those feelings are true.
dialogues.text: At the very least, I know those feelings are true.

dialogues.jp: ◆デート◆
dialogues.en: ◆A Date with Kotori◆
dialogues.text: ◆A Date with Kotori◆

dialogues.jp: ことりとのデート。
dialogues.en: I was on a date with Kotori.
dialogues.text: I was on a date with Kotori.

dialogues.jp:
行き先は商店街で、暦先生の結婚祝いのプレゼ
ントを選びたいとの事。
dialogues.en:
We went to the shopping district to find a wedding present
for Koyomi-sensei.
dialogues.text:
We went to the shopping district to find a wedding present
for Koyomi-sensei.

dialogues.jp:
その時俺は、ふと思い出してしまった。ことり
の夢を。初めて出会った家族と、訴える夢を…。
dialogues.en:
Then, I remembered. Kotori's dream. Her dream about the
first time she met her family, her cry for help.
dialogues.text:
Then, I remembered. Kotori's dream. Her dream about the
first time she met her family, her cry for help.

dialogues.jp:
俺達は、何か隠し事をしているのかもしれない。
けど、お互いがお互いを好きだった。それは、
確かだった。
dialogues.en:
We seemed to have secrets that we were both keeping from
each other. But at the very least, we knew we loved each
other.
dialogues.text:
We seemed to have secrets that we were both keeping from
each other. But at the very least, we knew we loved each
other.
